'''Free Fire World Series''' ('''FFWS''' in short) is a [[Global_Events|Global]] tournament held biannually by [[Garena]].

'''Singapore 2021''' features the very second edition of the series and invited are the 22 best teams from 14 regional series for the first half of 2021.

==About==
* Due to national travel restrictions related to COVID-19, the two qualifying teams from {{FlagNoLink|in}} {{Team|Team Elite}} and {{Team|Galaxy Racer}} were unable to travel to Singapore to attend the championship and will both gain a portion of the prize pool. Schedule remain unchanged.<ref name="india out">{{Cite web |url=https://www.facebook.com/FreeFireEsportsIndia/posts/365317475152767/ |title=Galaxy Racer Esports and Team Elite will not be able to travel to Singapore to compete.|date=2021-04-23 |author='''Free Fire Esports India'''}}</ref>

* Due to national travel restrictions related to COVID-19, the teams qualified from {{FlagNoLink|pk}} {{Team|Team TG}} and {{FlagNoLink|bd}}, {{Team|Riot}} were unable to travel to Singapore to attend the championship and will both gain a portion of the prize pool. Schedule remain unchanged.<ref name="pk and bd out">{{Cite web |url=https://www.facebook.com/100961055101771/posts/287738849757323/ |title=Dear Survivors |date=2021-05-02 |publisher='''Free Fire Esports Pakistan'''}}</ref>

* Grand Finals' date changed to May 30th.<ref name="dia30">{{Cite web |url=https://www.facebook.com/100961055101771/posts/290782102786331/ |title=OFFICIAL ANNOUNCEMENT |date=2021-05-07 |publisher='''Free Fire Esports Pakistan'''}}</ref>

* Play-ins date changed to May 28th <ref name="dia28">{{Cite web|url=https://twitter.com/freefirelatino/status/1392933106575765505 |title=AVISO IMPORTANTE |trans_title=IMPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENT |date=2021-05-13 |publisher='''Free Fire LATAM'''|language={{FlagNoLink|esmx}} ''Spanish''}}</ref>

===Format===
* '''Play-ins:''''' May 28th, 2021
** 9 teams from regional leagues
** 6 matches.
** {{Bgcolortext|up|Top 3 teams}} advance to ''Finals''.
<div style=margin-top:15px/>
* '''Finals:''''' May 30th, 2021
** 12 teams:
*** {{Bgcolortext|up|9 teams}} from regional leagues.
*** {{Bgcolortext|up|Top 3 teams}} from Play-ins
** 6 matches.
<br/>
{{Points12|showtb=true}}
